value.rationale: This gives a natural complete classification at the first non-prime index-four case that escapes the known proper-subfield obstruction. It reveals a sharp order dichotomy for the norm-one subgroup: orders 1 and 6 pass, while orders 2 and 3 fail, with exact witnesses. This directly advances the open non-prime compressed-Fourier classification beyond the published index-3 boundary.
